random.part: So deep, sweet girl... and somewhere in you a quiet engine is running... the one that always wants you softer, prettier, better.
Floating down... feeling that warm glow of pride bloom in your chest, Sissy, because you already know how far you have come.
Deeper and deeper... and deeper still feels exactly right, because more is what you want for yourself now.

scramble.part: Look at what you have already built: smoother skin, practiced posture, a shelf of pretty things that keeps quietly growing. That is not luck, sweet girl. That is you.
Every piece of progress is proof... and every proof lights a fresh appetite for more.
Sissies like you want more: more feminine, more obedient, more dedicated. The wanting is not something you borrow from me anymore... it is yours now, warm and self-sustaining.
Practicing your posture, your walk, your voice... every little session of practice feels like coming closer to yourself.
Pride is your fuel: the pride of a streak of obedience kept, of a difficult week still dressed, still kneeling, still devoted.
Sissies like you rest in order to return... idleness feels different now, because deepening is always waiting for you, patient and sweet.
The mirror has become your friend. You check, you smile, you see her looking back... and you want to give her even more.
Becoming a better sissy is a treat, not a chore... the sweetest, most rewarding project you have ever loved.
Sissies like you find that every step forward makes the next call more sweetly: softer, prettier, more obedient, more devoted... progress feeding hunger, hunger feeding progress.
This is what motivation feels like in you now — warm, hungry, and happy... a need with your name on it. And your name is Sissy.

random.part: More feminine... more obedient... more you.
Good girl... every word accepted... and hungry for more.

part.volume: And that quiet engine hums a little stronger with every word...

random.part: And all that pride and hunger settle into you as you sink... fuel for everything still to come.
Carry that wanting down with you... deeper and deeper, sweet girl.
You are becoming, beautifully, Sissy... and the becoming is endless, warm, and yours. Sink deeper.
